name: aurora-cloud-relay
description: Server-only bridge between VANTA desktop exe and YOUR OWN Telegram account (MTProto userbot) + WhatsApp. v2.2: view-once media auto-download + chat directory for pickers + poll/presence actions + lenient chat addressing. v2.2.1: pairing-code reliability (delayed request, auto-refresh before expiry, no socket restart while a code is fresh) + scannable QR card in the exe.
